title: Hill at Hatshepsut's mortuary temple 5,300 m from Karnak's obelisks

tellings.quote: surrounding the Hacheps Mortuary is another one of these white horse hills. Exactly 5,300 m away from the obelisks within the Carnac Temple.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm says that near the mortuary temple of Hatshepsut, a temple built for an ancient Egyptian queen near Luxor, there is another of what he calls "white horse hills." He says it lies exactly 5,300 metres from the obelisks, tall stone pillars, at the Karnak Temple. He tells it to suggest the ancient sites were laid out on purpose, by precise measurement, as one connected plan.
